author: Quaero I
title: Squeeze-and-Excitation ResNet (SE-ResNet)
abstract: Following the failure of a full self-attention model, this submission explores a more constrained and efficient form of attention. Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) blocks are integrated into the state-of-the-art 4-block, k=11 ResNet architecture. The hypothesis is that these SE blocks will improve performance by learning to dynamically re-weight the importance of different feature channels within each residual block, allowing the model to focus on the most informative features without the instability of a full self-attention layer.
